correctness.rationale: Equation (1) is obtained by expanding XY=YX; split/nonsplit two-eigenvalue forms have six disjoint U3-orbits of size q^2, a three-distinct stratum of size q^3 only for q>2, and nilpotent scalar-diagonal stratum of size 3q+1. Diagonal-projection dimensions exclude all cross-stratum coincidences. Rank-refined totals sum to claimed count. Exhaustive symbolic rowspace enumeration independently matched GF(2),GF(3),GF(4),GF(5),GF(7). No finite test treated as universal proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural finite-algebra invariant (literal count of distinct element centralizers), with full codimension distribution and a nonpolynomial q=2 exception. It resolves equality rather than conjugacy and quantitatively classifies the attainable commuting constraints/closed-neighborhood types of a standard matrix algebra over all finite fields. Although size three is fixed, the result is an exact infinite-field-order classification rather than arbitrary small isolated data.
